channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin heads to Malvern for another valuation day where Kate Bateman and Adam Partridge lead the team of experts. Adam finds a set of playing cards with hand-written predictions, and Kate meets a mystery monk - a bronze statue that has everyone wondering what it was used for. Paul visits Whitley Court, the huge ruins of a former stately home, and uncovers its fascinating history.
